title: First Steps
tagline: a loop, a keypress, a world that answers
hints: The loop is `while (std::getline(std::cin, cmd))`. When getline finally fails the input has run out - that is your 'quiet' ending.
Work out the target square FIRST, into `nx` and `ny`, then ask `d.isWall(nx, ny)` once. Do not write four copies of the wall check.
Up is `ny = py - 1`, because row 0 is the top. Down is `+1`. This trips everyone once.
Only count a step when the move actually happened. A bump into a wall is not a step.
Print the message BEFORE you render, and only render when the player moved. Blocked moves print a line and nothing else.
